pad.title: Buffs
pad.help.row.desc: how it works, with an example for your party
pad.help.title: Help
pad.help.body:
# What it is
The menu casts buffs by group with one press. The mod picks the caster,
spends slots and skips targets that already have the buff.

# Groups
Normal (N) — long buffs: hours, 10 min/level. Cast after resting.
Quick (Q) — minutes/level. Before entering a dangerous area.
Important (I) — round buffs. Right before a boss fight.

# L5 button
Press — this menu. Hold 0.6 s — Normal. Double press — Important.
Without the menu the result pops up at the top for 5 seconds.

# Main menu
Up/down — row. A — apply group or open item.
X — all groups in turn. Y — setup. B — close.
A group row shows buffs, active/needed and the next expiry.
Yellow — some buffs dropped, green — all active.
"Buffing in combat" — allow groups during combat (off by default:
casting is instant and costs no actions).

# Buff setup
LB/RB — tabs: Assigned (has targets), All, per group.
Up/down — buff, left/right — character.
A — toggle target, Y — whole party, X — change group (N → Q → I).
Green character — target. Struck out — this buff cannot target them.
On the right: group letters and targets out of possible.
Everything is saved at once, per playthrough.

# Messages
"applied X/Y, already active Z" — Y attempts, Z targets already had it.
"no caster" — casters are out of slots, rest.
"not started" — in combat while "Buffing in combat" is off.

use.azatazippymagic: Control Azata Zippy Magic Secondary Buff
caster.rank-tooltip: Higher priority casts earlier. Default order when priorities are equal: active party before reserve, spells before scrolls and potions, then prepared casters before spontaneous ones (higher caster level first). 'This buff' overrides 'all buffs' for this spell only — a grey value follows the all-buffs priority.
caster.mount-tooltip: Shown when several of this character's pets are rideable (e.g. an animal companion and a grown Aivu) — Saddle Up cannot decide on its own then. Pick the pet to mount here; Auto only mounts when a single pet is suitable.
caster.fury-tooltip: Shown when Shifter's Fury has more than one natural weapon to pick from (e.g. bite and claws). Choose the weapon the routine should enable here; Auto reuses the game's own last pick. Resting rebuilds the shifter's weapon list and switches Shifter's Fury off, so a saved pick is what lets the routine bring it back on its own.
settings-toggle: Toggle the Buff It 2 The Limit settings panel
setting-cast-all-combat-start: Cast all buffs on combat start
setting-cast-all-combat-start-tooltip: When combat begins, automatically cast every configured buff — as if 'Cast on combat start' were ticked on each one. Individual buff settings are left untouched.
setting-bypass-asf-tooltip: While prebuffing out of combat, ignores the arcane spell failure chance from worn armor so armored arcane casters buff reliably. No effect once combat has started.
setting-overwritebuff-tooltip: Recast buffs even on characters who already have them. When off, anyone who already carries a buff is skipped.
setting-verbose-tooltip: Cast each buff with its full spellcasting animation. When off (the default), buffs are applied instantly — far faster for big routines.
setting-umd-retries-tooltip: When casting from a scroll needs a Use Magic Device check, reroll a failed check up to this many times before skipping that scroll.
setting-umd-mode-tooltip: When may a character use a scroll whose spell isn't on their class list (a UMD check)? 'Safe casters only' never does. 'Allow if DC reachable' tries only when a natural 20 could pass. 'Always try' attempts whenever the character has any UMD skill, even if it can't succeed.
setting-source-priority-tooltip: Default order for choosing a cast source when a buff is available from several — spells, scrolls, or potions. Individual buffs can override this with their own priority.
setting-bypass-asf: Bypass arcane spell failure when prebuffing
openbuffs.tooltip.desc: Directly open the Buff It 2 The Limit configuration menu
settings-clear-all-tooltip: Removes every character assignment from every buff. Groups, source toggles and other per-buff settings are kept. Requires two clicks.
reserve.toggle.tooltip: Show all recruited companions, including those not in the active party
use.combatstart.tooltip: Automatically cast this buff when combat begins
deactivate.after.rounds.tooltip: Automatically deactivate this ability after N combat rounds. 0 = no limit.
